title: A hosted catalogue: approve its key, list signed packs from two hosts, install one

do.text: Before the run: launchers/store/hosted_proof (.bat or .sh) with --serve, which pushes a signed catalogue to a local Pages branch and serves it; pass the URL it prints as --var catalogue=URL.

steps.say: Meet the hosted catalogue as a new federated source, with a scratch trust list.

do.text: The probe refuses to list before approval, then needs every pack signed and installs the newest one with the client's own installer.
